neet_che_u07_t04_4.working: Both statements are true. R explains why conductivity falls on dilution. It does not explain why molar conductivity rises, which is due to reduced interionic attraction and the larger volume containing one mole.

neet_che_u07_t04_5.working: κ = 1.2 S m^-1 = 0.012 S cm^-1; Λm = 1000 × 0.012 / 0.1 = 120 S cm^2 mol^-1, not 12000, so I is incorrect. A depends on the charge type of the electrolyte, so II is correct.
